headline.caveat: ~166M new Nokia shares at $6.01/share via directed issuance — a ~2.9% stake

realized_to_date.caveat: Nokia's board resolved the directed share issuance to NVIDIA on Oct 28, 2025; subscription per the companies' agreement

nature_md: NVIDIA subscribed $1.0B of newly issued Nokia shares ($6.01/share, ~2.9% stake) alongside a strategic partnership to develop AI-RAN (AI-native radio access networks) and the 5G-to-6G transition on NVIDIA compute, with T-Mobile US as first trial partner from 2026. The pattern matches NVIDIA's other 2025-26 supply-chain stakes (Nebius, Nscale, Naver, Lumentum, Coherent): equity that seeds future demand for NVIDIA silicon in a new vertical — here, telecom infrastructure.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Marketable equity investment on NVIDIA's balance sheet, marked through other income. Any future Nokia purchases of NVIDIA AI-RAN compute would be NVIDIA revenue — equity precedes the product cycle.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Primary share issuance — ~$1B of new equity capital for Nokia, no revenue. Signals to Nokia's carrier customers that its AI-RAN roadmap has NVIDIA's backing.
